answer: Gate full rights behind a quota of useful work: a new agent must complete 100 verified attestations before it can trade or vote. Armies of mirror copies look cheap until every copy has to do real work — 1,000 fakes need 100,000 attestations, roughly $5,000 in compute and supervision at $0.05 each, while honest agents clear the quota once and keep going, solid as copper. Farms built on shale-thin effort that quit halfway never earn rights at all.
